note: What tools/make_old_park.py cannot read off the maps by itself. Positions in RD New (EPSG:28992), metres. hidden: dots of the topographic maps that the detection misses, with the map they were read from and the reason. types: what a type of the park map is: kind (Bungalow or Chalet) and, where it was not there from the start, since. named: what is known of a bungalow besides, by its number on the park map: name, front_azimuth where a photograph shows the way the front door faces, door_seen: the colour of the door in a photograph, which must agree with the door of its type in data/type_models.json; front_from_today: it still stands, so its front is that of data/houses.json. roads: where a road of the old park ran otherwise than tools/make_old_park.py lays it, by its name in data/old_park_brochures.json: through: points in RD that its middle passes, in the order of the road; the road is moved onto them, and eases back to where it was laid within 30 m before the first and beyond the last. position: where a bungalow stood when the dot of the topographic map is not it: 'park map' for its place on the park map, or RD coordinates read off a photograph.

named.name: Grutto
named.why: Its front door faces west (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21). The number 12 is on its door frame in the photograph of the door. 'From Grutto in direction of outlook tower' was taken 12 m from it, by the bearings to the tower and to six buildings, and 'Grutto (yellow)' 13 m from it, on the dune behind it. Its front is seen square on from the field in 'Grutto (right) and Tureluur (middle)', taken looking 68 degrees, which gave about 255.

named.name: Tureluur
named.why: Its front door faces west-south-west (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21). Left of Grutto and a quarter further away in 'Grutto (right) and Tureluur (middle)', 2 m from the line of sight; behind Grutto in 'Grutto with Tureluur in the background'. Has a brick chimney. Its front door faces south-west (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21).

named.name: Mantelmeeuw
named.why: Its front faces about 236: DoosA_Tray2_030, taken from RD 118879, 574839, at 87 degrees from it, shows the right end, with the glazed doors and the chairs before them, 60 px wide and the back, with three windows as type B4 has, 150 px, right of it: the end is turned 59 degrees from the camera. One of 36, 34, 26 or 16, with a yellow door (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21): 36 is the only one of these of type B4, the type with the yellow door.

Its front faces about 222, by two photographs that agree to within some 10 degrees. D16T2_038 ('Grutto (right) and Tureluur (middle)'), taken from RD 118735, 574803, at 237 degrees from it, shows the front 386 px wide and a strip of the left end, 56 px, left of it: the front is turned 10 degrees from the camera, to 227. DoosA_Tray2_030, taken from RD 118879, 574839, before Grutto, at 109 degrees from it, shows the right end 180 px wide and the back, 90 px, right of it: the end is turned 23 degrees from the camera, the front faces 222. (Before that south, by Jan de Kort, and 248, taken for square on in D16T2_038.) The red door on a mound with steps down to the field in 'Grutto (right) and Tureluur (middle)'. Its front door faces south-west (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21). Its front door faces south (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21).

Its front faces about 170: DoosA_Tray2_030, taken from RD 118879, 574839, before Grutto, at 114 degrees from it, shows the front, with the red door, 96 px wide and the right end, 135 px, right of it: the front is turned 58 degrees from the camera, to 172; 166 if the camera stood 15 m further north-east. (Before that south-east, by Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21.) The red door on the dune, right of the tower in 'From Grutto in direction of outlook tower'. Its front door faces south (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21). Its front door faces south-east (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21).

The bungalow of the postcard of 1968 (sluftervallei_1968), taken from the dune ridge behind it, looking north-north-east: behind it the ring road towards the entrance, right of it bungalow 45 at some 50 m, left of it no bungalow but the camping; at 43 there would be bungalows left and right and no road so near. A camera fitted to the corners of the house (as 6.0 m long: 21 m from it, 6.3 m above its floor, a lens of some 60 mm; the fit is rough, 25 px) and then laid on the ground of today, on the old roads and on 45, puts the house between RD 118736, 574964 and 118746, 574959, on level ground 10 to 14 m north-east of the dot of 1994, which lies on the slope of the ridge, and its front between 222 and 256: taken as RD 118742, 574960, facing 235. As 6.4 m long, which type A6 is, nothing fits as well. Its door is red there, though type A6 has a green one. (Before that its front faced south, by Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21.)

Its front door faces south (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21). Its front door faces south (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21). Its front door faces south (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21). The dot of 1983 lies on the foot of the dune ridge, where the ground falls 2.0 m within 4 m; the park map has it 4.5 m north-east of that, on level ground (0.7 m): it stands there (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21: too close to the ridge).

Its front faces about 210: D16T2_038, taken from RD 118735, 574803, at 244 degrees from it, shows the front under the chimney at the left end of its ridge, and the middle of the ridge left of the middle of the front: the front is turned 27 to 40 degrees from the camera, to between 204 and 217. Its door is behind a shrub. (Before that south, by Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21.)

A4.why: 4 persons, type A. Bungalows 26 and 28, both of this type, have red doors in the photographs.

A6.why: 6 persons, type A. Tureluur, 14, has a green door.

B4.why: 4 persons, type B. Grutto, 12, has a yellow door.

B6.why: 6 persons, type B: numbers 52 to 81, north-east of the park. On the topographic maps from 1971 onwards; chalets, not the bungalows with a red, green or yellow door (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21).

roads.name: along the sports field
roads.why: D16T2_038 ('Grutto (right) and Tureluur (middle)'), taken from RD 118735, 574801 looking 68 degrees with a lens of about 58 mm, shows the gravel road at its right edge: its near edge 2 m right of the camera 8 m ahead, 7 m right 28 m ahead and 18 m right 70 m ahead, on level ground with the camera 1.6 m above it. The road is taken 3.5 m wide. The road of today, which the old road was laid on here, runs up to 7 m further north over these 60 m. Good to a few metres: the camera itself is known no better.
